project_type: PHP + Python FastAPI web application with Docker Compose
build_system: Docker Compose with 3 services (php-frontend, ai-backend, mysql)
test_framework: pytest for Python backend (47 tests passing)
verification_instructions: Verify all markdown files are properly formatted and reference correct file paths. Verify README.md update does not break existing content.
snapshot_or_generated_files: evaluation_charts/*.png (generated by visualize_evaluation.py), references_images/*.png (pre-existing reference images)
setup_instructions: git clone, cp .env.example .env, docker compose up --build
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network - no Docker daemon, no package installs. Validation is limited to file content checks and AST validation.
key_patterns: Documentation is in Bahasa Indonesia for user-facing content but English for technical docs. README is mixed. Evaluation charts in ai_backend/training/evaluation_charts/. Reference images in references_images/.
directory_structure: Root: README.md, docker-compose.yml, Dockerfile.php. ai_backend/: FastAPI app with training/, models/, tests/. website/: PHP frontend. database/: SQL files. demo/: demo_script.py. references_images/: market/ML diagrams. docs/: (to be created)
